انتهجتن (form VII)
# اِنْتَهَجْتُنَّ (intahajtunna) /in.ta.had͡ʒ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اُنْتُهِجْتُنَّ (untuhijtunna) /un.tu.hid͡ʒ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
